name: Dragapult ex — Hammerpult
summary: Example deck showing what a deck page looks like. Straight Dragapult ex with Crushing Hammers, Munkidori and a Chi-Yu answer to Legendary Stadiums.
list:
Pokémon: 19
4 Dreepy ASC 247
4 Drakloak ASC 248
2 Dragapult ex PRE 165
1 Dragapult ex TWM 130
2 Munkidori TWM 95
1 Budew ASC 221
1 Chi-Yu TWM 39
1 Dunsparce TEF 128
1 Dudunsparce TEF 129
1 Meowth ex POR 121
1 Fezandipiti ex SFA 92

Trainer: 32
4 Lillie's Determination MEG 184
2 Boss's Orders LOR-TG 24
1 Boss's Orders MEG 114
2 Crispin PRE 171
1 Rosa's Encouragement POR 123
1 Judge POR 76
4 Crushing Hammer POR 71
4 Buddy-Buddy Poffin TWM 223
4 Poké Pad POR 113
2 Night Stretcher SSP 251
1 Night Stretcher ASC 196
3 Ultra Ball BRS 186

1 Basic {R} Energy SVE 10

1 Basic {P} Energy CRZ 156
3 Basic {D} Energy MEE 15

setup: Open with Dreepy (or Budew/Munkidori if no Dreepy) and use Buddy-Buddy Poffin for two Dreepy on turn 1.
Attach Energy to a Dreepy every turn; Phantom Dive needs one Fire and one Psychic.
Dunsparce goes down early so Dudunsparce can draw from turn 2.
turns: Turn 1: two Dreepy, Dunsparce, attach Energy. Meowth ex only if you need a Supporter.
Turn 2: evolve to Drakloak and use Recon Directive on each; Crushing Hammer if they powered up a big attacker.
Turn 3: Dragapult ex, Phantom Dive. Put the 6 counters where they set up a two-KO turn next.
Turn 4 on: keep one Dragapult ex building on the bench; Munkidori moves 3 counters to finish KOs.
tips: Count prizes before placing counters: 60 on a 2-prize Pokémon with 260 HP left is worth more than chip damage everywhere.
Unfair Stamp is your comeback card after they take a KO.
Risky Ruins bumps Legendary Pyroduct, which otherwise shuts off Drakloak and Dudunsparce.

setup: Bench two Dreepy and Dunsparce turn 1; keep Crushing Hammers for their Fire and Lightning Energy.
turns: Turn 2: Drakloak ×2. Hammer the Energy on a benched Rayquaza: Storm Emerald counts Energy on their whole board.
Turn 3: Phantom Dive the Active and drop 6 counters on a benched Mega Rayquaza ex (280 HP).
Next turn: Boss's Orders it and Phantom Dive (200) plus Munkidori (30) on top of the 60 = 290, a 3-prize KO.
tips: Two Mega KOs win. Spend gusts on Rayquaza and Kangaskhan, not Talonflame ex (2 prizes).
Legendary Pyroduct turns off Drakloak and Dudunsparce. Risky Ruins or Chi-Yu's Ground Melter removes it.
Keep Meowth ex and Fezandipiti ex off the bench after setup; Kangaskhan KOs them for 2.

setup: Race to the first Phantom Dive and keep the bench small: your Dreepy (70 HP) dies to their spread.
turns: Turn 2: Drakloak and Recon Directive. Hammer their Dragapult line's Energy if they're a turn ahead.
Turn 3: Phantom Dive their Active and put counters on their Drakloak (90 HP) or Dreepy to set up a double KO.
Later: trade Dragapult for Dragapult and win on bench prizes.
tips: The player who takes more bench prizes wins the mirror.
Unfair Stamp right after they take a KO.
Save Boss's Orders for a damaged Dragapult ex on their bench.

setup: They attack on turn 1. Lead with a single-prize Pokémon and bench only what you need.
turns: Turn 1–2: expect your Active to be KO'd; keep two Dreepy lines going.
Turn 2: Hammer whichever attacker they powered (Raging Bolt ex, Clefairy ex).
Turn 3+: Phantom Dive 2-prize targets and gust Lillie's Clefairy ex as soon as it lands.
tips: Lillie's Clefairy ex makes your Dragon Pokémon weak to Psychic. KO it first.
Every Pokémon they have gives 2 or 3 prizes: three KOs, or two on Kangaskhan, win.
Real results favor Basic Box here (59%), so play for tempo, not value.

setup: Bench Dunsparce early; this is a long single-prize game and Dudunsparce keeps you drawing.
turns: Turn 2: KO Slowpoke before it evolves if you can reach it.
Turn 3+: Phantom Dive OHKOs Slowking (120 HP); spread on benched Slowpoke (70 HP) for 2 prizes a turn.
tips: If they bench Lillie's Clefairy ex you become Psychic-weak: gust it first.
They use few Energy, so save Crushing Hammer for Mega Kangaskhan ex.
Don't overextend: every extra benched Pokémon is a prize for them.

setup: Take out their engine: Meganium (160 HP, 1 prize) doubles their Energy.
turns: Turn 2: Hammer the Ogerpon that has the most Energy.
Turn 3: Phantom Dive Teal Mask Ogerpon ex (210 HP) with Munkidori, or gust Meganium.
Later: spread 60 onto Hydrapple ex (330 HP) early so two hits are enough.
tips: Myriad Leaf Shower counts Energy on both Active Pokémon, so a lightly-powered Active takes less damage.
Hydrapple ex heals, so finish it in back-to-back turns.
This is even on Limitless (50%).

setup: Their damage is 2 counters per card in their hand. Judge and Unfair Stamp shrink it.
turns: Turn 2: spread is not online yet; gust Abra or Kadabra with Boss's Orders if it stops Alakazam.
Turn 3+: Phantom Dive OHKOs Alakazam (140 HP); put counters on Abra (50) and Kadabra (80).
tips: Judge the turn before they plan a big Powerful Hand.
Every one of their Pokémon is single-prize, so bench KOs are how you win the race.
Favored on Limitless (55%).

setup: Zoroark ex has 280 HP. Pre-damage the benched one so your next Phantom Dive KOs it.
turns: Turn 2: KO N's Zorua (70 HP) on the bench with Boss's Orders if you can.
Turn 3: Phantom Dive and put 60 on the benched Zoroark ex.
Next: gust it: 200 + 60 + Munkidori 30 = 290, a KO.
tips: Team Rocket's Watchtower does nothing to you (Dragapult isn't Colorless).
Their Munkidori moves counters onto your Pokémon too; count it before you leave a Dragapult at low HP.
Unfavored on Limitless (38%): you need the spread plan to work.

setup: Mega Excadrill ex needs a lot of Metal Energy, so Crushing Hammer is at its best here.
turns: Turn 2: Hammer whatever Energy they attached; spread later on Beldum or Metang to slow their engine.
Turn 3+: two Phantom Dives with 60 pre-placed KO a 340 HP Excadrill for 3 prizes.
tips: Don't let Excadrill reach 2 extra Energy: Maximum Drilling then does 330 and OHKOs you.
Two Mega KOs win the game.
Close to even on Limitless (46%).

setup: Their Hide 'n' Sneak Pokémon ignore your bench counters. Spread only works on Dhelmise and their ex.
turns: Turn 2–3: gust Lillie's Clefairy ex the moment it hits the bench.
Turn 3+: Phantom Dive OHKOs Dhelmise (140 HP); put spread on Clefairy ex or Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex.
tips: Clefairy ex makes Dragapult weak to Psychic, letting Dhelmise OHKO you. It is your number one target.
Chi-Yu (single prize) is a good trade into Banette.
Your worst matchup on Limitless (36%).

setup: Each Cursed Blast they use gives you a prize. Keep 130-HP-or-less 2-prizers off your bench.
turns: Turn 2: spread is not online, so Hammer the Kangaskhan's Energy.
Turn 3+: Phantom Dive Talonflame ex (280 HP) with 60 already on it plus Munkidori for a KO; put counters on Duskull and Dusclops.
tips: Mega Kangaskhan ex has 300 HP: plan two hits, and take the 3 prizes.
Don't bench Meowth ex late: Cursed Blast plus an attack takes it for 2.
Favored on Limitless (62%).
